title: Gridfinity bin design
description: A single bin design exported from the Gridfinity Layout Tool bin designer. Unknown properties are allowed so newer files still validate. This schema is an AUTHORING contract: it enforces enums and ranges strictly, while `required` lists only what the importer genuinely rejects a file for. Every other BinParams field is non-optional in TypeScript but is backfilled by migrateParams on load, so a hand-authored file may omit it. See https://gridfinitylayouttool.com/schema

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema. Ignored by the importer; present only so editors offer completion.

type.description: Document discriminator. The importer rejects any other value.

version.description: Document format version. Always "1.0". The importer never branches on it; backward compatibility is handled by migrateParams instead.

name.description: Design name. Also seeds the export filename.

AccentBandConfig.description: A horizontal accent band of a different colour.

BaseConfig.description: How the bin attaches to a baseplate, and what its underside looks like. The bin coordinate system puts Z=0 at the socket-box interface.

style.description: Base attachment style. This is a string union, not an enum: the UI derives it from boolean toggles via computeBaseStyle().

stackingLip.description: Add the Gridfinity stacking lip at the rim so another bin can sit on top.

solid.description: Fill the base solid instead of hollowing it.

halfSockets.description: Use half-pitch sockets on the underside.

footLatticeX.description: Foot lattice pitch along X. 'half' places feet every 0.5 unit.

feet.description: Whether feet are printed as part of the body or as separate pin-mounted parts.

feetPinDiameter.description: Pin diameter in mm for detachable feet. Only meaningful when feet is 'detachable'.

spacer.description: Build a floorless spacer used to shim a stack between odd and even total heights. A spacer may be 1u tall; nothing else may.

tile.description: Build a baseplate-style tile rather than a bin body.

BezierHandle.description: Bezier control handle, a relative offset in mm from its point.

BinParams.description: The complete bin parameter set handed to the generator. Dimensions are in GRID units; everything ending in Mm is millimetres. Never mix the two.

width.description: Width in grid units. 0.5 increments allowed.

depth.description: Depth in grid units. 0.5 increments allowed.

height.description: Height in HEIGHT units, not mm. 1u is base only and is legal for spacers; every other base style needs at least 2u for a usable cavity.

fractionalEdgeX.description: Side the half-unit foot column sits on when width is fractional. 'end' = right, 'start' = left. Lets a 2.5x2 bin pick its side without rotating the print, which would move the front scoop.

fractionalEdgeY.description: Side the half-unit foot row sits on when depth is fractional. 'end' = back, 'start' = front.

fractionalEdgeManualX.description: True once the user deliberately chose the X fractional edge. Suppresses the drawer-mismatch warning for that axis only.

fractionalEdgeManualY.description: True once the user deliberately chose the Y fractional edge.

gridUnitMm.description: Millimetres per grid unit along X. Also the square grid unit when gridUnitMmY is omitted.

gridUnitMmY.description: Millimetres per grid unit along Y for a non-square grid, e.g. 42x22. Omitted or equal to gridUnitMm means square. Only the cell pitch stretches; round features stay isotropic.

magnetAnchor.description: Magnet hole anchor. INJECTED from the owning layout at generation time so bin, lid and baseplate magnets stay mated. Do not rely on it in a standalone design file.

nozzleSizeMm.description: Print nozzle in mm that a label socket's pocket clearance scales to. INJECTED transiently at generation time and never persisted, so a printer's nozzle never syncs to other devices or rides along in a shared design. Should not appear in an exported file.

heightUnitMm.description: Millimetres per height unit. Standard Gridfinity is 7.

wallThickness.description: Outer wall thickness in mm. 0.4 is one wall line on a 0.4mm nozzle; 2.4 is three lines on a 0.8mm nozzle.

style.description: Bin interior style. 'standard' is a walled cavity, 'slotted' adds divider slots, 'solid' is a filled block that cutouts are cut into.

inserts.description: Cavities cut into the bin floor. May be empty.

cutouts.description: Top-down cavity cuts, used mainly by the 'solid' style. May be empty.

meshAssets.description: Imported STL imprint meshes keyed by the id that a shape 'mesh' Cutout's meshId references. Omit for designs without mesh imprints.

cutoutGroupNames.description: Display names for cutout groups, keyed by group id. Omit unnamed groups; they fall back to a derived label.

extraWallHeightMm.description: Extra exterior wall height in mm ABOVE the nominal bin height. Outer walls and stacking lip rise; the interior floor, cutouts, dividers, scoops and label tabs stay anchored at the original top plane. A collar of dead headroom. 0 reproduces the standard bin exactly.

CellMask.description: Custom footprint mask for a non-rectangular bin. Stored at HALF-BIN resolution unconditionally: a width x depth bin has a (2*width) x (2*depth) mask. When omitted, or when every cell is filled, the bin uses the faster rectangle path. When present and partial, features that cannot yet operate on a non-rectangular footprint are skipped: compartments, cutouts, walls, handles, inserts, scoops and label tabs.

cells.description: Row-major occupancy, 0 or 1. Length MUST equal cols * rows.

CompartmentConfig.description: The interior compartment grid. cells is a ROW-MAJOR parallel array whose length MUST equal cols * rows; the importer rejects a mismatch. The per-compartment arrays (compartmentTexts, labelIcons, compartmentColors, ...) are parallel to cells and are remapped together when compartments merge or split.

cols.description: Compartment columns. Capped at 12 because a 16x16 grid risks a generation timeout.

cells.description: Row-major compartment id per grid cell. Length MUST equal cols * rows. Cells sharing an id are one merged compartment.

compartmentTexts.description: Per-compartment engraved text, parallel to the compartment id space.

labelPlateWidths.description: Per-compartment label plate width in grid units.

compartmentColors.description: Per-compartment hex colour for multi-colour export.

compartmentColorScopes.description: Whether a compartment's colour covers just its floor or its walls too.

drawnUnitCells.description: Unit cells painted by the compartment drawing tool.

stash.description: Bento stash of saved compartment shapes.

dividerHeight.description: Divider wall height in mm. Shorter than the cavity leaves an open top between compartments.

mergeBackground.description: Bento mode: leftover grid merges into one pocket per connected region instead of a field of 1x1 pockets, so the interior can take a C/L/S/T/U outline.

backgroundIds.description: Ids of the merged leftover regions, so a multi-cell compartment nobody drew still reads as background.

Cutout.description: A top-down cavity cut, mainly for the 'solid' style. x and y are in MILLIMETRES from the bin interior's left/front edge, not grid units.

id.description: Unique cutout id within the design.

shape.description: Cutout shape. 'path' needs a valid path array; 'mesh' needs meshId; 'polygon' needs sides.

x.description: X position in mm from the bin interior's left edge.

y.description: Y position in mm from the bin interior's front edge.

width.description: Width in mm, or diameter for a circle.

depth.description: Depth in mm. Ignored for a circle.

cutDepth.description: How deep the cut goes in mm.

label.description: Text engraved next to the cutout.

groupId.description: Boolean group this cutout belongs to.

parentGroups.description: Enclosing arrange-only groups, outermost first, excluding this cutout's own groupId. Omit for a top-level cutout; every member of a group repeats the same chain.

scoopRadiusW.description: Scoop radius along width in mm.

scoopRadiusD.description: Scoop radius along depth in mm.

name.description: Display name in the cutout list.

hidden.description: Hide from the preview without deleting.

path.description: Pen-tool path. Required for shape 'path'. Duplicate consecutive vertices make the worker fall back to a bounding box, which renders as a plain rectangle in 3D while looking correct in 2D.

sides.description: Polygon side count. Only meaningful for shape 'polygon'.

clearance.description: Extra clearance in mm around the cut.

chamferWidth.description: Chamfer width in mm at the cut's mouth.

leanDeg.description: Tilt of the pocket's axis off vertical in degrees, about the opening along the shape's local depth axis; cutDepth is measured along the tilted axis. Ignored for mesh and knifeSlot shapes.

engraveLabel.description: Engrave the label text next to this cutout.

textSide.description: Which side of the cutout the label sits on.

colorScope.description: Whether the colour covers just the cut floor or its walls too.

labelMode.description: 'engrave' cuts the label text into the surface; 'socket' builds a pocket for a separately printed swappable label plate.

labelPlateWidthU.description: Label plate width in grid units for socket mode.

labelIcon.description: Icon id engraved with the label.

meshId.description: Key into BinParams.meshAssets. Required for shape 'mesh'.

CutoutArrayConfig.description: Repeat a cutout in a grid, staggered grid, or ring. Total instances are capped at 400.

cols.description: Columns. Grid and staggered modes only.

rows.description: Rows. Grid and staggered modes only.

radius.description: Ring radius in mm for radial mode.

startAngle.description: Starting angle in degrees for radial mode.

rotateToCenter.description: Rotate each instance to face the ring centre. Forced off for a grouped repeat, which copies the whole assembly.

labels.description: Per-copy engraved labels, in reading order: top row first and left to right for grid and staggered, around the ring from the first copy for radial. Omit to label the whole repeat once with the cutout's own label. An entry present in the list wins, blank included; copies past the end of a short list fall back to the cutout's label.

topOffset.description: Lowers the solid fill surface below the rim in mm. 0 is flush with the rim.

fillReference.description: Which end topOffset is held against when the bin's wall height changes.

CutoutScoopEdges.description: Which edges of a cutout are scooped. All four default to true when the whole object is absent.

DividerOverride.description: Geometry override for the divider between two compartments.

offsetStart.description: Offset in mm at the divider's start end.

offsetEnd.description: Offset in mm at the divider's far end.

DividerPieceConfig.description: The separately printed divider pieces that ride in the slots.

clearance.description: Fit clearance in mm between divider and slot.

ExportMeta.description: Provenance stamp added on export. Never load-bearing.

exportedFrom.description: Origin URL of the exporting app.

FeatureColorConfig.description: Per-feature filament colour assignment for multi-colour 3MF export. Colours are hex strings; a zone left unset inherits the body colour.

FloorPatternConfig.description: Drainage or ventilation perforation of the bin floor. The cut passes through the floor slab AND the base socket under it, so holes drain instead of ending in a blind pocket.

pattern.description: Floor pattern type. A subset of the wall patterns; kumiko patterns are not available here.

HandleConfig.description: Grip cutouts in the bin walls.

width.description: Handle width as a PERCENTAGE of the wall span.

verticalPosition.description: Handle centre as a FRACTION of wall height, 0 at the floor.

interior.description: Also cut handles in interior divider walls.

enabled.description: Enable a handle on this wall.

width.description: Width override as a percentage of wall span.

Insert.description: A cavity cut into the bin floor. Positions are in MILLIMETRES from the bin interior's left/front edge.

templateId.description: Template this insert came from, or null if hand-placed.

x.description: X in mm from the bin interior's left edge.

y.description: Y in mm from the bin interior's front edge.

width.description: Width in mm, or diameter for circle and hexagon.

depth.description: Depth in mm. Ignored for circle and hexagon.

cutDepth.description: How deep the cavity goes in mm.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees. Only right angles.

KnifeRestConfig.description: Handle rest for a knife block: a saddle-topped companion solid, or an integrated rear section, carrying knife handles at the height the knifeSlot cutouts imply.

style.description: 'companion' is a separate part placed as a paired bin; 'integrated' builds it into the block.

gapMm.description: Gap in mm between block and rest.

presetId.description: Preset knife id, when one was chosen.

handleWidthMm.description: Handle width across the slot's thin direction in mm. Sizes the rest saddle groove.

handleHeightMm.description: Handle height in the blade's edge-to-spine direction in mm. Sizes the rest saddle height.

openEnd.description: Which end of the slot is open.

LabelTabConfig.description: Label shelf across the bin's compartments. Mixed units again: depth, height, inset and lipHeight are millimetres, width is a percentage.

mode.description: 'text' engraves directly on the tab. 'socket' builds a pocket for a separately printed swappable label plate.

plateFitOffset.description: Fit offset in mm applied to a socket's pocket. Positive is looser. Only meaningful in 'socket' mode.

socketStyle.description: Which socket profile a 'socket' mode tab uses. 'clickIn' snaps the plate down onto a shelf; 'slideChannel' slides it in from the side.

support.description: Support structure under the tab. 'bracket' is open gussets, 'solid' is a filled triangle, 'fillet' is a curve.

depth.description: Tab depth in MILLIMETRES. The UI further clamps to min(50, innerDepth - 1) so the tab cannot span past the opposite wall.

width.description: Tab width as a PERCENTAGE of the compartment column width.

height.description: Z position in mm of the shelf TOP above the cavity floor. Absent means the wall top. Lowering it creates a tuck-under pocket between rim and shelf.

lip.description: Add a raised rim on the tab's free edge to retain loose label cards.

lipHeight.description: Lip height in mm. Reserves that much shelf headroom.

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment of the tab within its span.

edges.description: Which wall the tabs anchor to.

inset.description: Inward offset in mm from the anchor wall. The UI clamps further per compartment depth so two tabs in 'both' mode cannot collide.

span.description: Span one tab across a whole row of compartments instead of one per column. When true, captions come from rowTexts.

LidConfig.description: Click-lock lid, generated as a separate companion solid. Indexed rather than fully documented in prose; the authoritative definitions live in src/features/bin-designer/types/lid.ts.

enabled.description: Generate a lid alongside the bin.

stackableTop.description: Give the lid a socket-patterned top so another bin can stack on it.

stackLipOnly.description: Emit only the stacking lip band rather than a full stackable top.

magnetHoles.description: Cut magnet holes in the lid.

separateStackPlate.description: Emit the stackable top as its own printable plate.

clickRailCoverage.description: Percentage of each side carrying the click rail.

extraHeightMm.description: Extra lid height in mm. The lid mirror of BinParams.extraWallHeightMm.

topThicknessMm.description: Lid top slab thickness in mm.

relieveInterior.description: Hollow the lid interior to save filament.

cutouts.description: Cutouts taken out of the lid, using the same Cutout shape as the bin.

LidGripConfig.description: A finger grip so the lid can be lifted off.

coverage.description: Percentage of each side the grip spans.

binDip.description: Dip the bin rim to meet the grip.

side.description: Which side the hinge is on.

catchMode.description: How the lid is held closed.

LidMagnetConfig.description: Retention magnets holding the lid down.

edgeMagnets.description: Place magnets at the edges rather than the corners.

LidSlideConfig.description: A sliding lid that rides in rails.

placement.description: Whether the lid sits flush with the rim or recessed below it.

entrySide.description: Which side the lid slides in from.

pull.description: Pull feature so the lid can be gripped.

detent.description: Add a detent that holds the lid closed.

LidTrayConfig.description: Turns the lid into a shallow tray.

MeshAsset.description: An imported STL imprint mesh, referenced by a shape 'mesh' Cutout's meshId. The payload is an opaque encoded blob; hand-authoring one is not practical.

name.description: Original file name, sanitized with the extension stripped.

triangleCount.description: Triangle count of the decoded mesh.

sizeMm.description: Oriented lay-flat bounding box size in mm.

outlines.description: Top-down silhouette outer rings with holes dropped, simplified. Powers the 2D footprint render without decoding the mesh.

MeshOutlinePoint.description: A point on a mesh silhouette ring, in mm.

OverhangConfig.description: Per-side outward expansion of a bin body in mm, letting a bin fill a gap an integral grid cannot express. Outward only. All-zero or omitted keeps the standard rectangle path. Ignored for cellMask bins. left/right are -X/+X and front/back are -Y/+Y, matching the grid.

enabled.description: Absent means enabled is inferred from any non-zero side.

feet.description: Add grid-aligned feet under the overhang region. False leaves a flat bottom with feet at the nominal footprint.

PathPoint.description: One pen-tool path point in mm, with optional bezier handles. Consecutive duplicate points make 3D generation silently fall back to a bounding box, which renders as a plain rectangle while the 2D preview still looks correct.

x.description: X in mm from the bin interior's left edge.

y.description: Y in mm from the bin interior's front edge.

handleIn.description: Incoming bezier control handle as a relative offset. null makes the point a hard corner.

handleOut.description: Outgoing bezier control handle as a relative offset. null makes the point a hard corner.

ScoopConfig.description: A curved or straight ramp at one wall so contents can be scooped out.

side.description: Which wall the scoop rises from.

run.description: Horizontal run of the scoop in mm.

autoMaxHeight.description: Let the scoop rise to the tallest printable height instead of a fixed one.

SideFlags.description: Per-side booleans. front/back are -Y/+Y and left/right are -X/+X, matching the grid.

SlideConfig.description: A sliding tray: a rail on this bin plus the companion tray that rides it.

railDropMm.description: How far the rail sits below the rim in mm.

railProtrusionMm.description: How far the rail protrudes inward in mm.

clearanceMm.description: Fit clearance in mm between rail and tray.

SlotConfig.description: Slots that removable dividers slide into. Only meaningful for the 'slotted' style.

longAxis.description: Which axis carries the full-length dividers. Honoured only when crossStyle is 'insert'.

partialStyle.description: Whether dividers span fully, snap to length, or come as a length set.

layout.description: Even pitch or a custom grid.

customGrid.description: Custom slot positions. Only meaningful when layout is 'custom'.

SplitConnectorConfig.description: Connectors joining the pieces of a bin too large for the print bed.

tongueProtrusion.description: How far the tongue protrudes in mm.

wallConnector.description: Whether the wall seam also gets a separate key.

ridgeWidthFraction.description: Ridge width as a fraction of the tongue.

ridgeHeightFraction.description: Ridge height as a fraction of the tongue.

nozzleSizeMm.description: Nozzle size the connector clearances scale to.

StashedCompartment.description: A saved compartment shape in the bento stash.

cells.description: Which cells of the w x h bounding box the shape fills, row-major with row 0 at the front. Length MUST equal w * h and at least one cell must be true. Omit it for a plain rectangle; an all-true mask is rejected. The filled cells must form one 4-connected region.

label.description: Optional label carried with the stashed shape.

SurfaceTextConfig.description: Text on exterior surfaces: the lid top and the outer walls. Omit for designs without surface text so they serialize byte-identically.

lidText.description: Text engraved or embossed on the lid top. Deliberately monochrome.

walls.description: Per-wall text keyed by side: front, back, left, right.

wallAlign.description: Per-wall vertical alignment keyed by side.

wallStyles.description: Per-wall style overrides keyed by side.

TextOffset.description: Text nudge from its anchor, in mm.

TextStyleDefaults.description: Design-level defaults for engraved text geometry on label tabs and next to cutouts. Individual instances may attach a TextStyleOverride.

mode.description: How the glyphs meet the surface.

depth.description: Engrave or emboss depth in mm.

margin.description: Margin in mm around the text block.

minFontSize.description: Lower bound in mm for auto-sized text.

maxFontSize.description: Upper bound in mm for auto-sized text.

anchor.description: Nine-point anchor within the available area.

sizeMode.description: 'auto' fits the text to the area; 'fixed' uses fixedSize.

fixedSize.description: Font size in mm when sizeMode is 'fixed'.

snapToScale.description: Snap the computed size to the shared type scale.

uniformAcrossWalls.description: Use one size for every wall rather than fitting each separately.

lineGap.description: Extra gap between lines in mm.

cutProfile.description: 'drafted' angles the glyph walls so an engraved cut releases cleanly.

draftAngleDeg.description: Draft angle in degrees. Only meaningful when cutProfile is 'drafted'.

TextStyleOverride.description: A sparse override onto TextStyleDefaults. Every TextStyleDefaults field is optional here, plus fontSizeOverride. Omitted fields are not reset.

fontSizeOverride.description: Hard font size in mm for this instance only, bypassing auto sizing.

TrayBottomConfig.description: Turns the bin underside into a lid-like tray bottom that mates with the bin below.

attachment.description: How the tray bottom attaches to the bin below.

extraHeightMm.description: Extra skirt depth in mm to clear contents protruding from the bin below.

clickRailCoverage.description: Percentage of each rail's side that carries the click feature.

WallConfig.description: Cutouts taken out of the bin's walls. Global width/depth are PERCENTAGES; per-side entries may override them.

shape.description: Cutout shape applied to all sides.

width.description: Default cutout width as a PERCENTAGE of the wall span, for sides without an override.

depth.description: Default cutout depth as a PERCENTAGE of wall height, measured from the top.

cornerRadiusTop.description: Default shoulder round-over in mm. null means square, which is what every design saved before this control had.

cornerRadiusBottom.description: Default bottom fillet in mm. null means the automatic 15%-of-span rule.

WallCutout.description: One wall's cutout. Note the mixed units: width and depth are percentages, offset and widthMm are millimetres.

enabled.description: Whether this side's cutout is on.

width.description: Cutout width as a PERCENTAGE of the wall span. Ignored when widthMm is set.

depth.description: Cutout depth as a PERCENTAGE of wall height, from the top.

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment within the wall span.

offset.description: Horizontal offset from the alignment anchor in MILLIMETRES. Positive is toward right/back.

widthMm.description: Absolute cutout width in mm. When null, the percentage width is used instead.

cornerRadiusTop.description: Shoulder round-over in mm. null defers to WallConfig.cornerRadiusTop.

cornerRadiusBottom.description: Bottom fillet in mm. null defers to WallConfig.cornerRadiusBottom.

WallPatternConfig.description: Decorative perforation of the bin walls. The pattern cut is the single most expensive generation step; large bins with a pattern can approach the generation timeout.

pattern.description: Pattern type. The last seven are kumiko patterns.

scale.description: Pattern cell scale. Smaller means more, finer cells and a slower cut.

dividers.description: Also apply the pattern to interior divider walls.

WallTaperConfig.description: Bottom-band taper on the outer wall. Full width at the rim, angling inward over bandHeight by up to each side's overhang so the base never drops below the nominal footprint.

enabled.description: Absent means enabled is inferred from any non-zero side.

bandHeight.description: How far up the wall the taper rises in mm, clamped to wall height at build.

left.description: Magnitude on -X in mm. Chamfer: base inset. Fillet: radius. 0 keeps the side vertical.
